purpose: Defines the CYNIC ports that external (non-CYNIC) projects may consume or produce. Roadmap item 7: 'Add an external project through the same ports.' Each port is a trait in a cynic-* crate behind a port adapter. Wiring is gated on observation (build/test baseline verified) and read-back proof.

ports.purpose: Clone, fetch, branch, push, and PR operations on external repositories. Reuses CYNIC's source lifecycle (contracts/source-lifecycle.json) parameterized by remote.
ports.notes: Trait + adapter defined. Forgejo adapter in cynic-vcs-forgejo. GitHub adapter pending.

ports.purpose: Run a project's observed build/test commands on the builder node (10.10.10.119) with read-back proof. Commands come from infra/external-projects.json (observed, not fabricated).
ports.notes: Trait + adapters defined. Local + SSH adapters in cynic-host. HTTP builder client available (resolve_builder_url).

ports.purpose: Ingest a project's findings/evidence into CYNIC's observation store (aegisscan findings -> CYNIC observation store).
ports.notes: Trait + adapter defined. Local adapter in cynic-host. Content-addressed store adapter pending.

wiring_rules: A port is 'candidate' until wired and observed. Aspirational wiring is forbidden.
Port wiring requires: (1) build/test baseline observed on builder, (2) read-back proof, (3) contract updated.
aegis-core (sanitized) may only consume SourcePort and BuildPort. EvidencePort is not applicable (no findings produced).
No cynic-* crate may gain a dependency on an external project. External projects are leaf consumers only (Strict DAG).
Port traits must be pure (no I/O). I/O lives in adapters/ (FCIS).
rules: Ports are defined in domain crates behind port traits (FCIS).
Adapters implement the traits with concrete I/O (SSH, HTTP, filesystem).
The CLI surface (cynic audit external) projects port status but does not own logic.
Port wiring is gated on observation. No port is 'wired' without read-back proof.
